name: Factory Showcase
description: One connected factory: raw ore, wood, stone and sand in at the west end, the Works Runabout built at the east end, every production machine working on the way. Read the signs, press Start on both consoles, then pick Works Runabout at the Building Station.

text: 1 POWER. MAIN SWITCH: off = every machine No power
2 REFINERY: press Start on this console
Ore to metal; metal and stone to steel
Wood to planks; planks and sand to rubber
Copper ore to copper; copper and metal to bronze
Planks to cloth; sand to glass
3 THE YARD: every refined material, in bins
